1.

Behold, behold what love The Father hath shewn us, How His eye resteth upon us With a wondrous tenderness! See, how He the best gift To the deepest sunken giveth, Giveth His Son for our salvation; See, how the Father hath us dear!

2.

Behold, behold what love The Lord Jesus beareth toward us, How all for us He suffered, The Lamb without blemish He is. See, how He in the anguish of the cross Poured out His blood, bowed in death. Who can comprehend such love, Love in its depth and height!

3.

Behold, behold what love Through the Spirit God displayeth, And to those whom He hath sealed Joy and peace and strength imparteth. With comfort and warning He faithfully leadeth us on. Thrice-great wonders of love, Let us highly sing the Lord’s name!
